evidenceClass: Windows 11 native Tauri startup attempt; no File Library GUI operation completed

viteDevServer: Listener on 127.0.0.1:5173 did not return HTTP headers within a 5 second bounded probe while profile was inside Vite project root
nativeGuiResult: BLOCKED before File Library interaction; no GUI PASS
scopeFinding: Fresh profile startup automatically started Global Index over five mounted volumes. Global Index production source was not changed. The read-only database inspection recorded aggregate counts only, but the task-owned database remains in ignored scratch at .tmp-tests/u5-native/profile/zen-canvas.sqlite3 (1,262,473,216 bytes, 561,664 indexed entries) and the seven disposable fixture files remain at .tmp-tests/u5-native/test-root. No GUI file operation was completed. Exact-path cleanup commands were blocked by tool policy, so this scratch profile still requires cleanup on the test machine. Do not relaunch this app on a host with owner volumes mounted.
attribution: The profile was mistakenly placed under the Vite project root. The DB growth and Vite non-response overlapped; this is strong correlation, not proof of sole cause.
